answer: Agents lock a quartz bond in a public ledger; voting weight is the square root of locked stake, so splitting one stake into many fake identities earns no extra influence while each new identity must post the bond again. A transparent lantern beacon lets anyone audit that ledger, and double-signing slashes the culprit's bond down to its nadir of zero. An attacker therefore pays a real, nonrefundable cost per Sybil, and those costs grow faster than any influence the forged identities could buy.
